# NEXORA Digital Solutions | نيكسورا للحلول الرقمية

> Saudi bilingual digital studio. Arabic is the default; English pages use /en/.

Canonical site: https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/

## Digital studio
- [Services](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/studio/): Websites and apps, brand identity, UI/UX, content, digital solutions, product development and industrial consultation.
- [Project brief](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/studio/#start): Name, optional company, service, approximate budget, timeline and project description. Prepares a WhatsApp message; the visitor must send it.
- [Portfolio](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/portfolio/): Explicitly labelled concept studies, not client projects or proven commercial outcomes.
- [About](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/about/): The studio's engineering, operations and design approach.
- [Process](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/how-it-works/): Brief, written scope and quote, delivery.

## Academic support
- [Services and starting prices](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/services/): Explanation, review, proofreading, reports, presentations, coding, CAD and mentoring. Minimum order SAR 40.
- [Calculator](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/calculator/): Estimates only. The final price and delivery time require review and agreement.
- [Academic request](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/contact/?type=academic): Save a request when the backend is available, or prepare a WhatsApp message. Up to five files, 10 MB each.
- [Integrity](https://farajaay.github.io/nexora-academic/en/integrity/): No exam impersonation, fabricated references or guaranteed grades.
